rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comforting someone who is grieving, disappointed, or upset.

example.english: I stayed with them all night to console them.
example.traditional: 我陪住佢，安慰咗佢一晚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pui4 zyu6 keoi5 on1 wai3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 maan5

rows.note: Use this when you mean helping someone work through distress or see things more positively.

example.english: They were very upset after the breakup, so I talked with them all night to console them.
example.traditional: 佢失戀好唔開心，我同佢傾咗成晚，開解佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sat1 lyun5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1 ngo5 tung4 keoi5 king1 zo2 seng4 maan5 hoi1 gaai2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this colloquial verb for soothing or coaxing someone, especially a child or a close person who is upset.

example.english: My son was crying, so I bought ice cream to console him.
example.traditional: 個仔喊緊，我買雪糕氹返佢。
example.jyutping: go3 zai2 haam3 gan2 ngo5 maai5 syut3 gou1 tam2 faan1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when the comforting involves cheering someone up or stopping them from crying, rather than offering serious consolation.

example.english: Hurry and console the little girl; she cannot stop crying.
example.traditional: 你快啲哄下阿妹，佢喊到停唔到。
example.jyutping: nei5 faai3 di1 hung3 haa5 aa3 mui6 keoi5 haam3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2
